metricDefinitions.newVocabulary: target final row count minus target baseline row count
metricDefinitions.newDictionaryEntries: final dictionary lemmas absent from baseline using production trim+lowercase lookup
metricDefinitions.modifiedExistingEntries: baseline dictionary lemmas whose final entry object differs using production trim+lowercase lookup
metricDefinitions.properNouns: unique proper-noun lemmas referenced in the final target range
metricDefinitions.multiWordExpressions: new target vocabulary rows whose lemma contains more than one word
metricDefinitions.stageDirectionEntries: final target vocabulary rows marked category=stage
metricDefinitions.polysemousWithInThisPlay: final target rows with inThisPlay whose dictionary entry is tagged/contextual or lists multiple senses
